# flap1.com

> Personal portfolio and blog of flap1. Developer, builder, Shih Tzu enthusiast.

## About

This is a personal website built with Astro 6. It contains a portfolio of projects,
blog posts, notes (TIL), and information about the author.

## Sections

- /: Home page with introduction
- /about: Biography and background
- /projects: Featured project case studies
- /blog: Technical blog posts
- /notes: Short TIL notes and learnings
- /uses: Tools, hardware, and software stack
- /now: Current focus and priorities
- /contact: Contact information
